text:
nora: FYI I opened a docs PR to cover the v1->v2 breaking items we promised: the param rename (model -> model_id) and the embeddings dimension bump. Need quick reviewer eyes and a short rollback-safe snippet.

jamal: Can you paste the minimal before/after snippets here? I want to scan for edgecases before we merge.

nora: Old v1 example (very common):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain X"}]}'
```

New v2 example suggested in PR:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id":"redwood-chat-2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain X"}]}'
```

li: Note: SDKs will accept both keys for a short period but we should not recommend relying on that. Add a clear deprecation banner.

frank: For embeddings: customers with precomputed indexes are most at risk. Suggest a compact detection + reindex guide. I drafted a one-liner check for docs CI: 
```bash
# returns length of first embedding vector
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id":"embed-lite-2","input":"probe"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```

jamal: Love the probe. Add a note showing 'expected_vs_actual' snippet for customers: if length != expected_dim then show reindex steps.

nora: Added in PR: short checklist — 1) run probe across sample docs, 2) if mismatch re-index into new namespace, 3) update app to point at new namespace, 4) run A/B queries for 48 hours, 5) retire old namespace after 30 days.

li: Can we include tiny compatibility shims for Node + Python for the sample repos? Keep them <=10 lines. Example idea (JS):
```js
function normalizeOpts(opts){
  if(opts.model_id) return opts;
  if(opts.model) opts.model_id = opts.model;
  return opts;
}
```

frank: Add one-liner unit tests in docs examples so reviewers notice regressions in CI. Eg: `assert(normalizeOpts({model:'a'}).model_id==='a')`.

nora: Good call. Also added a small FAQ entry: "Why is my vector DB failing similarity queries?" with a reproducible smoke test and links to the reindex script in the samples repo.

support-bot: Auto-note: created support ticket template for Dedicated/Private customers that need reindex assistance. Ticket ID: TKT-5921.

jamal: We should also schedule automated redirects for older pages that link to /v1/ endpoints. I can run a repo grep and open mass-redirect PRs for the top 30 pages.

nora: Please do — added a follow-up task in PR description with the grep results.

li: wording nit: in the banner use "deprecated" not "removed" until removal date is listed. Make timeline explicit.

nora: Timeline added: hosted: 45 days dual-support, then 30 days deprecation notice before removal; dedicated/private: consult ops (will coordinate on request).

frank: One more operational note: include a short rollback snippet showing how to map model_id back to model in-app if a rollback is needed quickly. Might be as small as mapping table in config.

nora: included a tiny config example and a short suggestion to use feature-flagged rollout for the change.

jamal: Action items in PR: (1) docs owners review (li, jamal) (2) add JS/Python shims to samples (frank) (3) ops/support ticket template for managed customers (nora/support-bot) (4) grep + redirect PRs (jamal) (5) add CI probe job to docs examples (li).

nora: Thanks all. Please review PR #4899 when you have 10m. If no blockers by EOD I'll merge and publish the banner. :rocket:
